description: Calculates maintenance fluid requirements by weight
template:
Maintenance Fluids (Holliday-Segar)

Calculates maintenance fluid requirements by weight

Holliday-Segar Method:
• First 10 kg: 100 mL/kg/day (4 mL/kg/hr)
• Next 10 kg (11-20 kg): 50 mL/kg/day (2 mL/kg/hr)
• Each kg >20 kg: 20 mL/kg/day (1 mL/kg/hr)
Example: 25 kg child = (10×100) + (10×50) + (5×20) = 1600 mL/day
Adjustments:
• Fever: ↑ 12.5% per °C >37.5°C
• Hyperventilation: ↑ 20-60%
• Humidity: ↓ 25-50% (incubator, humidified air)
